STEP 1 - Scene: A small plated salad of leafy greens (arugula-like) with a few light-colored pieces (possibly cheese or egg white) and some orange/brown bits (possibly dried tomato or nuts). Photographed from above, roughly top-down, on a white square plate sitting on a wooden/glass table.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 26 × 26 × ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 575 cm²; using a 26 cm round equivalent, 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: (a) leafy greens, arugula-like, dressed with a glossy coating (likely light oil/dressing); (b) pale pieces, likely shaved cheese or egg; (c) small orange-brown bits, likely dried tomato or nut pieces.

STEP 4 - Area: Greens cover about 17% of the plate (the pile sits on the right side, roughly 90 cm² of 531 cm²). Pale pieces ~2% (about 10 cm²). Orange-brown bits ~1% (about 5 cm²). Total food coverage ≈ 20%.

STEP 5 - Volume: Greens: 90 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 225 ml. Pale pieces: 10 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 5 ml. Orange-brown bits: 5 cm² × 0.4 cm ≈ 2 ml. Dressing sheen: ~2 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Greens: 225 ml × 0.15 ≈ 34 g. Cheese/egg: 5 ml × 0.9 ≈ 5 g. Dried tomato/nuts: 2 ml × 0.6 ≈ 1 g. Oil/dressing: ~3 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Arugula/leafy greens at 25 kcal/100 g → 34 g ≈ 9 kcal. Cheese (hard, pale) at 400 kcal/100 g → 5 g ≈ 20 kcal. Dried tomato/nut bits at 250 kcal/100 g → 1 g ≈ 3 kcal. Oil at 880 kcal/100 g → 3 g ≈ 26 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The visible food is a modest side salad covering about a fifth of a large plate, so a total of roughly 40–45 g and about 60 kcal is plausible for what is visible. Estimates are rough given the single top-down photo.

Total: ~43 g, ~58 kcal.
